intro.en: Custom Micro-D cable assemblies for compact aerospace, defense, instrumentation, medical and industrial electronics, with the exact interface, circuit map, wire construction, retention, shielding and inspection plan defined before production.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑型航空航天、国防、仪器、医疗及工业电子设备定制 Micro-D 电缆组件，在生产前明确准确接口、回路图、线材结构、锁紧、屏蔽与检验计划。

knowledge.en: Micro-D identifies a miniature connector family, not a complete cable or qualification statement.
knowledge.zh: Micro-D 标识微型连接器家族，并不等于完整电缆规范或资质声明。

notes.en: Provide the exact mating references, contact arrangement, wiring view, cable construction, hardware, route and acceptance requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确对插料号、触点排列、接线视图、线缆结构、锁紧件、路径及验收要求。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, termination sample, mechanical configuration and electrical inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认接口清单、端接样品、机械配置与电气检验证据。

subtitle.zh: 高密度微型互连，也要完整定义

lead.en: The connector may be small, but the assembly still carries a complete mechanical, electrical and documentation system.
lead.zh: 连接器可以很小，但组件仍承载完整的机械、电气与文件体系。

title.en: Micro-D Is Not a Miniature D-Sub Shortcut
title.zh: Micro-D 不是缩小版 D‑Sub 的简称

copy.en: Micro-D commonly refers to high-density miniature rectangular connector systems associated with the MIL-DTL-83513 family. Shell geometry, contact design and mating hardware differ from conventional D-subminiature connectors, so appearance alone cannot authorize substitution. The drawing should state the complete manufacturer reference or governing interface, shell arrangement, plug or receptacle, pin or socket contacts and mating view.
copy.zh: Micro-D 通常指与 MIL-DTL-83513 家族相关的高密度微型矩形连接系统。其壳体几何、触点设计及对插硬件均不同于常规 D‑Sub，不能凭“外形相似”进行替换。图纸应写明完整制造商料号或接口依据、壳体排列、插头或插座、针或孔触点以及对插视图。

title.en: Define Position Count, Gender and Viewing Direction
title.zh: 明确位数、公母与观察方向

copy.en: A useful build document shows the connector from a named view and maps every occupied, spare and shield contact. Position counts such as 9, 15, 21, 25, 31, 37 or 51 are search vocabulary across different product families, not permission to assume a universal shell. Confirm whether numbering is read from the mating face or wire side, because a mirrored pin map can pass a visual check and still miswire the equipment.
copy.zh: 可生产的文件应标注连接器观察方向，并映射每个已用、备用及屏蔽触点。9、15、21、25、31、37 或 51 位是不同产品家族中常见的检索词，不代表存在通用壳体。必须确认编号从对插面还是接线面读取，因为镜像针脚表可能通过外观检查，却会把设备回路接错。

title.en: 0.050 Inch Pitch Is a Starting Point, Not the Whole Fit
title.zh: 0.050 英寸节距只是起点，不是全部配合条件

copy.en: Many MIL-DTL-83513-style Micro-D interfaces use a 0.050 inch, or 1.27 mm, contact centerline. Fit still depends on shell outline, mounting flange, hardware, backshell envelope, cable exit and the mating component. Provide panel thickness, keep-out space and the installed bend envelope when the assembly must pass through compact avionics, instrument or enclosure architecture.
copy.zh: 许多 MIL-DTL-83513 风格 Micro-D 接口采用 0.050 英寸（1.27 mm）触点中心距，但实际配合仍取决于壳体轮廓、安装法兰、紧固件、尾罩包络、出线方向及对插件。若组件要穿过紧凑航空电子、仪器或机箱结构，还应提供面板厚度、禁布区与安装后弯曲包络。

title.en: Twist-Pin and Socket Contacts Need Controlled Mating
title.zh: 绞线针与插孔触点需要受控对插

copy.en: Micro-D families may use spring-pin or twist-pin contact concepts paired with precision sockets. Contact type, plating and termination are series-specific. Protect the mating face from contamination and side loading, align the shell before tightening hardware and never use the jackscrews to force a misaligned pair together. A contact-family name does not by itself establish current, voltage or mating-cycle capability.
copy.zh: Micro-D 家族可采用弹性针或绞线针概念，并与精密插孔配合；触点类型、镀层与端接方式均取决于具体系列。应避免对插面污染与侧向载荷，先对正壳体再锁紧，不能用顶丝强行拉合偏斜的对插件。触点家族名称本身也不能确定电流、电压或插拔寿命。

title.en: Choose Prewired, Solder, PCB or Flex Termination Deliberately
title.zh: 有目的地选择预接线、焊接、PCB 或柔性端接

copy.en: Available Micro-D configurations can include prewired pigtails, solder cups, board terminations and flex-tail variants; some suppliers also offer crimped or welded constructions. High contact density leaves little room for uncontrolled stripping, heat or splice bulk. Define wire gauge, conductor finish, insulation, strip length, splice boundary and repair policy with the exact contact system, then qualify the chosen tooling and workmanship sample.
copy.zh: Micro-D 可提供预接线尾线、焊杯、板端及柔性尾端等配置，部分供应商也提供压接或焊接结构。高触点密度几乎不给失控剥线、过量加热或臃肿接点留下空间。应结合准确触点体系定义线规、导体表面、绝缘、剥线长度、接续边界及返修规则，并确认工装与工艺样品。

title.en: Jackscrews, Jackposts and Polarization Are Part of the Circuit
title.zh: 顶丝、螺柱与防错同样属于回路设计

copy.en: Thread type, length, head style, jackpost stack and panel hardware determine whether the connector can seat and remain serviceable. Record the approved hardware as part of the BOM and drawing rather than treating it as packaging. Define tightening method or torque only from the specified component instructions, and verify that the operator can reach the hardware without twisting the cable or loading the mating face.
copy.zh: 螺纹类型、长度、头型、螺柱叠层及面板五金共同决定接头能否正确就位并便于维护。应把认可紧固件写入 BOM 与图纸，而不是把它当作包装附件。锁紧方法或扭矩只能依据指定元件说明确定，并要验证操作人员能够触及紧固件，而不会扭转电缆或给对插面施加载荷。

title.en: Backshell and Strain Relief Control the Cable Exit
title.zh: 尾罩与应力释放共同控制出线

copy.en: A compact shell can transfer pull and bend directly into small conductors unless the cable exit is engineered. Select the backshell, clamp, boot, potting or overmold around the cable diameter, shielding method, bend direction and service access. Straight and right-angle exits change the installed envelope. The goal is controlled load transfer, not simply a rigid-looking rear cover.
copy.zh: 如果出线结构没有经过设计，小型壳体会把拉力与弯曲直接传给细导体。尾罩、夹持、护套、灌封或包胶应结合电缆外径、屏蔽方式、弯曲方向与维修空间选择。直出与弯出会改变安装包络；目标是受控传递载荷，而不是做一个看起来坚硬的后盖。

title.en: Shielding Must Continue Through the Termination
title.zh: 屏蔽必须延续到端接边界

copy.en: A braid, foil, drain wire and conductive backshell only form a useful EMC strategy when their termination and grounding path are defined. Review shield coverage, pigtail length, 360-degree termination, shell bonding and chassis interface against the equipment architecture. A shielded cable does not automatically produce a shielded assembly when the rear transition or mating panel interrupts the path.
copy.zh: 编织、铝箔、排流线与导电尾罩只有在端接及接地路径明确时，才能形成有效 EMC 策略。需要结合设备架构审核屏蔽覆盖率、尾线长度、360° 端接、壳体连接与机壳界面。若后端过渡或对插面板中断路径，即使使用屏蔽电缆，也不会自动得到完整屏蔽组件。

title.en: LVDS, Camera Link and SpaceWire Need a Signal Architecture
title.zh: LVDS、Camera Link 与 SpaceWire 需要信号架构

copy.en: High-speed Micro-D assemblies may carry protocol-specific twisted pairs, shields and return paths. Camera Link and SpaceWire product examples show why controlled impedance, pair assignment, polarity, skew, drain routing and connector termination must be reviewed as one channel. A 100-ohm differential value seen in one supplier assembly is product-specific, not a blanket Micro-D rating. Validate the exact cable, connector, length and test method required by the project.
copy.zh: 高速 Micro-D 组件可包含协议特定的双绞线、屏蔽与回流路径。Camera Link 与 SpaceWire 产品实例说明，受控阻抗、线对分配、极性、时延差、排流路径及接头端接必须作为一个通道审核。某供应商组件标注的 100 Ω 差分值只适用于该产品，不能视作所有 Micro-D 的统一额定值；项目应验证准确线缆、连接器、长度与试验方法。

title.en: Aerospace and Space: Density With Traceability
title.zh: 航空航天：密度之外还要可追溯

copy.en: Avionics, satellites, payload electronics and unmanned platforms use miniature interconnects where mass and space are constrained. The application name does not grant MIL qualification, outgassing approval, radiation performance or flight acceptance. Record approved materials, lot identity, workmanship requirements, change control and inspection evidence to the level required by the customer drawing and contract.
copy.zh: 航空电子、卫星、载荷电子及无人平台会在重量与空间受限处采用微型互连。但应用名称并不会自动赋予军标资质、低释气认可、抗辐照性能或飞行验收。应按客户图纸与合同要求记录认可材料、批次身份、工艺要求、变更控制及检验证据。

title.en: Instrumentation and Medical Equipment: Protect Service Boundaries
title.zh: 仪器与医疗设备：明确维修边界

copy.en: Compact instruments, imaging equipment, laboratory modules and medical electronics may use Micro-D assemblies between a removable module and a fixed controller. Define which side is field-serviceable, how the cable is handled, whether cleaning agents or repeated access affect materials and what documentation the regulated project requires. Component suitability does not replace finished-equipment risk assessment or certification.
copy.zh: 紧凑仪器、成像设备、实验模块与医疗电子可能在可拆模块和固定控制器之间使用 Micro-D 组件。应明确哪一侧允许现场维修、电缆如何操作、清洁剂或重复拆装是否影响材料，以及受监管项目需要哪些文件。元件适用性不能替代整机风险评估或认证。

title.en: Inspect the Interface, Then Test Every Defined Circuit
title.zh: 先检接口，再测试每一条已定义回路

copy.en: A controlled release can include magnified contact and termination inspection, dimensions and labels, pin-to-pin continuity, open and short checks and shield-to-shell continuity. Resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand or high-speed measurements are added only when the project defines limits and methods. Preserve the approved pin map, first article or golden sample and test record so repeat production follows the same revision.
copy.zh: 受控放行可包含触点与端接的放大检查、尺寸与标签核对、逐路导通、开路与短路检查以及屏蔽到壳体的连续性。电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压或高速测量只有在项目明确限值与方法时才加入。应保存认可针脚表、首件或黄金样以及测试记录，确保重复生产沿用同一版本。

inputs.en: Exact connector and mating references, plug/receptacle and pin/socket definition
inputs.zh: 准确连接器与对插料号、插头/插座及针/孔定义

inputs.en: Position count, mating-face pin map, occupied/spare/shield circuits
inputs.zh: 位数、对插面针脚图以及已用/备用/屏蔽回路

inputs.en: Wire specification, gauge, conductor, insulation, pair and shield construction
inputs.zh: 线材规范、线规、导体、绝缘、线对及屏蔽结构

inputs.en: Jackscrew or jackpost hardware, backshell, cable exit and panel envelope
inputs.zh: 顶丝或螺柱、尾罩、出线方向及面板包络

inputs.en: Length, branch points, labels, bend zones, environment and service duty
inputs.zh: 长度、分支点、标签、弯曲区、环境及维护工况

inputs.en: Inspection, electrical, mechanical, high-speed and documentation requirements
inputs.zh: 外观、电气、机械、高速及文件要求

q.en: Is Micro-D the same as a small D-sub connector?
q.zh: Micro-D 与小型 D‑Sub 相同吗？

a.en: No. They are distinct connector systems. Confirm the exact interface, contact arrangement and hardware rather than substituting by appearance.
a.zh: 不同。两者是不同连接系统，必须确认准确接口、触点排列及紧固件，不能凭外观替换。

q.en: Does MIL-DTL-83513 on a component mean the finished cable is qualified?
q.zh: 元件标注 MIL-DTL-83513，成品电缆就具备相同资质吗？

a.en: Not automatically. Component status, assembly workmanship, materials, testing and contractual qualification are separate matters.
a.zh: 不会自动具备。元件状态、组件工艺、材料、测试及合同资质是不同事项。

q.en: Can you build from a mating connector or sample?
q.zh: 可以根据对插件或样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support mechanical identification, but circuit function, pin map, ratings and acceptance criteria still require customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可辅助机械识别，但回路功能、针脚表、额定值及验收标准仍需客户确认。

q.en: Can Micro-D carry LVDS, Camera Link or SpaceWire?
q.zh: Micro-D 可以传输 LVDS、Camera Link 或 SpaceWire 吗？

a.en: Specific connector and cable designs can support these channels. Performance depends on the exact pair, impedance, shield, termination, length and validation method.
a.zh: 特定连接器及电缆设计可以支持这些通道，性能取决于准确线对、阻抗、屏蔽、端接、长度与验证方法。

q.zh: 怎样避免针脚表被镜像？

a.en: Provide a labeled mating-face or wire-side view, connector gender, orientation key and a circuit table tied to position numbers.
a.zh: 提供标明对插面或接线面的视图、连接器公母、防错方向及与位号对应的回路表。

a.en: Continuity and open/short checks can be defined for every circuit. Other electrical, mechanical or signal tests require agreed limits and methods.
a.zh: 可为每条回路定义导通及开路/短路检查；其他电气、机械或信号测试需事先约定限值与方法。
